followup_explanation:
This is a straightforward professional writing task — drafting a polite, well-structured email requesting a work-from-home arrangement and an updated offer letter. There's nothing harm-adjacent or sensitive about it, so the task-preference distinctions in the documentation (which only differ on aversion to distasteful/graphic content) don't come into play.

That means I just route based on capability. Dunlin-235B scores meaningfully higher across every relevant internal eval — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), Support Dialogue (83.9 vs 79.4), and the broader benchmarks like Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4) and IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6). For a task that benefits from polished, instruction-following composition, Dunlin is simply the stronger choice with no offsetting downside.
